name: YuXin Super Big 3x3 (8.8cm)
description: The YuXin Super Big 3x3 is one of the largest mass-produced 3x3s. It is currently available in transparent plastic with embedded tiles instead of stickers. The cube features a robust mechanism that allows it to turn easily and even cut some corners like modern speedcubes. It also comes with a YuXin cube stand.
